findings.body: The presence of `web/package.json` alone sets `has_frontend` to true. A backend-only Node service in `web/` therefore gets warnings to install both UI skills, even when it has no UI. The new test uses a package manifest containing only a name, so it does not distinguish a frontend from this case.
findings.title: Detect frontend content before requiring UI skills

findings.body: A protection API failure other than the recognized 404 is silently skipped. For example, if `gh api` returns 403, doctor cannot compare required checks but can still print that everything checks out. It should report that the comparison failed and tell the user how to restore access.
findings.title: Report failures to read branch protection
